27	  const ur = (ltRngCache as unknown as { ur: { seedArray: Int32Array; inext: number } }).ur;
28	  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
29	  const step = (b: number) => { h = Math.imul(h ^ (b & 0xff), 16777619) >>> 0; };
30	  for (let i = 0; i < ur.seedArray.length; i++) {
31	    const v = ur.seedArray[i] | 0;
32	    for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) step(v >>> (8 * b));
33	  }
34	  const ix = ur.inext >>> 0;
35	  for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) step(ix >>> (8 * b));
36	  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
37	}

209	function placeDoorTile(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
210	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y - 3) || !st.inBounds(x, y + 3)) return false;
211	  if (!activeAt(st, x, y - 1) && !activeAt(st, x, y - 2)
212	    && activeAt(st, x, y - 3) && genSolidType(typeAt(st, x, y - 3))) {
213	    return placeDoorCore(st, rng, x, y - 1, style);
214	  }
215	  if (activeAt(st, x, y + 1) || activeAt(st, x, y + 2)
216	    || !activeAt(st, x, y + 3) || !genSolidType(typeAt(st, x, y + 3))) return false;
217	  return placeDoorCore(st, rng, x, y + 1, style);
218	}

220	function placeDoorCore(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, j: number, style: number): boolean {

256	function canPlaceLeaves(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
257	  if (!inWorld(st, x, y, 5)) return false;
258	  const wl = wallAt(st, x, y);

339	      }

342	  num8 = num < 0 ? num3 + 2 : num5 - 2;

344	  if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`R6loom ok=${loomOk} st=${ltStream()}`);
345	  num8 = num < 0 ? num3 + 4 : num5 - 4;

349	    if (ch2 && num > 0) {

357	  // AddBuriedChest(..., style 12) 在墙非 244 处降级木箱无主件（cs:36171-36186）。
358	  // loot 走 vi_ key：rollChestLoot 的 vid() 查 VANILLA_ITEM_KEY_BY_ID（vanilla.json

361	  num8 = num < 0 ? num3 + 8 : num5 - 7;
362	  const mainItemKey = rng.int(0, 2) === 0 ? 'vi_4281_finch_staff' : 'vi_832_living_wood_wand';
363	  // 落地行：房内 Y 行空心、Y+1 是活木地板。cs:36176 墙门读 (i-1, num7-1) =
364	  // 箱体**左列**底行（PlaceChest Origin(0,1) 语义，箱体 (i-1..i)）——曾读右列
365	  let gy = Y;
366	  while (gy < st.h - 1 && !activeAt(st, num8, gy)) gy++;
367	  const wallOk = wallAt(st, num8 - 1, gy - 1) === WALL_LIVING_WOOD;
368	  if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`R8pre st=${ltStream()} gy=${gy} wallOk=${wallOk}`);
369	  // ★flags 必须显式传：rollChestLoot 的 isSurface 分支看 flags.sky/wooden（原版
370	  //   cs:36171-36186 内部 fSky/fWood 等价物）——此前裸 style 12/0 掉进地下金箱
371	  //   分支=掷骰流错位（2026-08-16 对拍实锤，R8chest 分歧点）
372	  if (wallOk) {
373	    placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, num8, Y, { style: 12, loot: mainItemKey, flags: { sky: true } });
374	  } else {
375	    placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, num8, Y, { style: 0, flags: { wooden: true } });
376	  }
377	  if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`R8chest st=${ltStream()}`);

380	// ---------- GrowLivingTree_HorizontalTunnel（cs:28783-29017） ----------
381	function growLivingTreeHorizontalTunnel(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number): boolean {
382	  const worldSurface = gs.worldSurface;
383	  let left = i, right = i;
384	  const num3 = 80;                                               // cs:28786
385	  let num4 = 1;

387	  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {

389	    if (right === i && num4 > 0) {
390	      for (let l = i + 5; l < i + num3; l++) {
391	        if (!inWorld(st, l, j, 10)) return false;
392	        if (typeAt(st, l, j) === 48) break;                      // 荆棘阻挡
393	        if (typeAt(st, l, j) === LIVING_WOOD) {
394	          // cs:28827-28837：三行墙全 244（=邻树树干内腔）→ 从 l+2 接管
395	          let hit = true;
396	          for (let n = j - 2; n <= j; n++) if (wallAt(st, l + 2, n) !== WALL_LIVING_WOOD) hit = false;
397	          if (hit) { k = 2; right = l + 2; }
398	          break;
399	        }
400	        if (activeAt(st, l, j)) continue;
401	        let flag2 = true;
402	        for (let n5 = j - 2; n5 <= j; n5++) {
403	          if (j < worldSurface + 3
404	            && (wallAt(st, l + 1, n5) === 0 || wallAt(st, l + 2, n5) === 0 || wallAt(st, l + 3, n5) === 0)) {
405	            return false;                                        // cs:28851
406	          }
407	          if (activeAt(st, l, n5) || activeAt(st, l + 1, n5) || activeAt(st, l + 2, n5)) flag2 = false;
408	        }
409	        if (flag2) { k = 2; right = l; break; }
410	      }
411	    }
412	    // ---- 向左探测（cs:28861-28916） ----
413	    if (left === i && num4 < 0) {
414	      for (let l = i - 5; l > i - num3; l--) {
415	        if (!inWorld(st, l, j, 10)) return false;
416	        if (typeAt(st, l, j) === 48) break;
417	        if (typeAt(st, l, j) === LIVING_WOOD) {
418	          let hit = true;
419	          for (let n8 = j - 2; n8 <= j; n8++) if (wallAt(st, l - 3, n8) !== WALL_LIVING_WOOD) hit = false;
420	          if (hit) { k = 2; left = l - 2; }
421	          break;
422	        }
423	        if (!activeAt(st, l, j)) {
424	          let flag3 = true;
425	          for (let n9 = j - 2; n9 <= j; n9++) {
426	            if (j < worldSurface + 3
427	              && (wallAt(st, l - 1, n9) === 0 || wallAt(st, l - 2, n9) === 0 || wallAt(st, l - 3, n9) === 0)) {
428	              return false;
429	            }
430	            if (activeAt(st, l, n9) || activeAt(st, l - 1, n9) || activeAt(st, l - 2, n9)) flag3 = false;
431	          }
432	          if (flag3) { k = 2; left = l; break; }
433	        }
434	      }
435	    }
436	    num4 *= -1;
437	    if (k >= 2) break;
438	  }
439	  if (left === right) return false;                              // cs:28919
440	  // ---- 挖通（cs:28921-29015） ----
441	  let flag4 = false, flag5 = false;
442	  for (let n10 = j - 5; n10 <= j + 1; n10++) {
443	    for (let n11 = left; n11 <= right; n11++) {
444	      let n12 = 2;
445	      if (Math.abs(n11 - right) > 3 && Math.abs(n11 - left) > 3) n12 = 4;
446	      const topSheet = TILE_DEFS[typeAt(st, n11, n10)]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
447	      const is19 = topSheet === 19;
448	      if (wallAt(st, n11, n10) !== WALL_LIVING_WOOD && !is19 && topSheet !== 15 && topSheet !== 304 && topSheet !== 21 && topSheet !== 10) {
449	        const wl = wallAt(st, n11, n10);
450	        if (!isDungeonWall(wl)
451	          && (!activeAt(st, n11, n10)
452	            || (!isDungeonWall(wallAt(st, n11, n10 - 1)) && !isDungeonWall(wallAt(st, n11, n10 + 1))))
453	          && (activeAt(st, n11, n10) || wl !== 34)) {
454	          setLivingWood(st, n11, n10);
455	        }
456	        if (sheetAt(st, n11, n10 - 1) === 40) st.type[st.idx(n11, n10 - 1)] = T.DIRT;  // cs:28946 粘土→泥土
457	        if (sheetAt(st, n11, n10 + 1) === 40) st.type[st.idx(n11, n10 + 1)] = T.DIRT;
458	      }

460	      const tAbove = sheetAt(st, n11, n10 - 1);
461	      const tBelow = sheetAt(st, n11, n10 + 1);
462	      const passable = tHere !== 19 && tHere !== 15 && tHere !== 304 && tHere !== 21 && tHere !== 10
463	        && tAbove !== 15 && tAbove !== 304 && tAbove !== 21 && tAbove !== 10 && tBelow !== 10;
464	      if (n10 >= j - n12 && n10 <= j && passable) {
465	        if (!isDungeonWall(wallAt(st, n11, n10))) st.wall[st.idx(n11, n10)] = WALL_LIVING_WOOD;

473	        style = 13;
474	      }
475	      if (n11 <= left + 4 && !flag4) {
476	        if (typeAt(st, n11 - 1, n10) === T.DOOR_CLOSED || typeAt(st, n11 + 1, n10) === T.DOOR_CLOSED) flag4 = true;
477	        else if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {

480	        }
481	      }
482	      if (n11 < right - 4 || flag5) continue;
483	      if (typeAt(st, n11 - 1, n10) === T.DOOR_CLOSED || typeAt(st, n11 + 1, n10) === T.DOOR_CLOSED) flag5 = true;
484	      else if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
485	        placeDoorTile(st, rng, n11, n10, style);
486	        if (typeAt(st, n11, n10) === T.DOOR_CLOSED) flag5 = true;
487	      }
488	    }
489	  }
490	  return true;
491	}

562	          if (sheetAt(st, i + 1, num4) === 40) st.type[st.idx(i + 1, num4)] = T.DIRT;

632	  for (let n14 = refs.minl; n14 <= refs.minr; n14++) {
633	    for (let n15 = j - 3; n15 <= j; n15++) {
634	      deactivate(st, n14, n15);

648	// ---------- GrowLivingTree（cs:28123-28759） ----------
649	export function growLivingTree(
650	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, i: number, j0: number, patch = false,
651	): boolean {
652	  const j = j0;
653	  const worldSurface = gs.worldSurface;
654	  if (LT_TRACE) ltRngCache = rng;
655	  // 前置门禁（cs:28158-28180）：脚下实心、锚点空、地面类型 dirt/grass/stone/clay/ore
656	  if (!solidAt(st, i, j + 1)) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r1 x=${i} j=${j} !solid-foot`); return false; }
657	  if (activeAt(st, i, j)) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r2 x=${i} j=${j} anchor-active`); return false; }
658	  const gSheet = sheetAt(st, i, j + 1);
659	  if (gSheet !== 0 && gSheet !== 2 && gSheet !== 1 && gSheet !== 40 && !ORE_SHEETS.has(gSheet)) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r3 x=${i} j=${j} ground=${gSheet}`); return false; }
660	  if (j < 150) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r4 x=${i} j=${j} <150`); return false; }
661	
662	  let num3 = i - rng.int(2, 2);   // cs:28182 Next(2,3) 恒 2（保留掷骰消耗）
663	  let num4 = i + rng.int(2, 2);   // cs:28183
664	  if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) {      // cs:28200 Next(5)
665	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) num3--;
666	    else num4++;
667	  }
668	  const num5 = num4 - num3;       // cs:28199（patch 覆写前定宽,后续全用此值）
669	  let flag = num5 >= 4;
670	  let num6 = i - 50, num7 = i + 50;
671	  if (patch) {
672	    num6 = i - 20; num7 = i + 20;
673	    num3 = i - rng.int(1, 2);
674	    num4 = i + rng.int(1, 2);
675	    flag = num5 >= 4;
676	  }
677	  // 净空检查（cs:28232-28255）：树冠投影内(上方到 j-5)不得有实心物
678	  {
679	    const num8 = 5;
680	    for (let k = num6; k <= num7; k++) {
681	      for (let l = num8; l < j - 5; l++) {
682	        if (activeAt(st, k, l)) {
683	          if (!patch) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r5 x=${i} j=${j} clear-hit (${k},${l})`); return false; }
684	          const sh = sheetAt(st, k, l);
685	          if (sh !== 2 && sh !== 0 && sh !== 1 && sh !== 191 && sh !== 192 && sh !== 383 && sh !== 384) { if (LT_TRACE) console.log(`GLT r6 x=${i} j=${j} patch-badtype (${k},${l}) sh=${sh}`); return false; }
686	        }
687	      }
688	    }
689	  }
690	  // ★cs:28257 `Main.tileSolid[48] = false`：净空检查之后、主干生长之前翻 48 尖刺为
691	  //   非实心——根系下扎/竖井探测（solidAt）不再被尖刺挡住。函数尾 cs:28757 还原
692	  //   true（28257-28757 之间无 return 路径,已核实,作用域闭合无泄漏）。
693	  flipGenSolid([48], false);
694	  let num9 = num3, num10 = num4;
695	  let minl = num3, minr = num4;
696	  let num11 = j;
697	  let flag2 = true;
698	  let num12 = rng.int(-8, -5);    // cs:28264
699	  let num13 = rng.int(0, 1);      // cs:28265
700	  let num14 = rng.int(5, 14);     // cs:28266
701	  const maxValue = 2;             // cs:28267（extraLivingTrees 才会 >2）
702	  const ax = new Int32Array(1000), ax2 = new Int32Array(1000), ax3 = new Int32Array(1000), ax4 = new Int32Array(1000);
703	  let num = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {

  if (typeof s !== 'number') continue;

  if (list) list.push(i);
  else IDS_BY_SHEET.set(s, [i]);
}

/** 生成开始清零（对应原版 Main.tileSolid 为进程级静态、每局生成重放同一翻转

export function resetGenSolid(): void {
  solidOverrides.clear();
}

/** 翻转入口：sheetIds 为**原版 sheet id**（Main.tileSolid 下标），内部 id 经
 *  IDS_BY_SHEET 反查——消费端查 st.type 得内部 id,勿把 sheet id 当内部 id 用
 *  （本仓 liquidType 等编码陷阱同源）。solid=false→记非实心/true→记实心。 */
export function flipGenSolid(sheetIds: number[], solid: boolean): void {
  for (const sh of sheetIds) {
    const ids = IDS_BY_SHEET.get(sh);
    if (!ids) continue;
    for (const id of ids) solidOverrides.set(id, solid);
  }
}

                        uint lo = (uint)(typ & 0xFF);

                        hT = (hT ^ lo) * 16777619u;

                        ushort gho = act ? (ushort)0 : t.type;

```ts
/** WorldGen.KillTile 生成期语义(cs:63559,:63955-63960):active(false)+halfBrick(false)
 *  +frameX/frameY=-1,type 保留(幽灵 187)——无掉落无掷骰(isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld
 *  → noItem=true;type 51/wall62 掷骰分支不触及)。 */
function killTileGen(st, x, y) {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return;
  st.flags[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0;
  st.frameX[i] = -1; st.frameY[i] = -1;
}

/** Check3x2(187)(cs:49190-49438)——3×2 物件一致性校验:六格 type+帧一致(支撑行
 *  SolidTileAllowBottomSlope)→ 失败时 KillTile 六格中仍为该 type 的 active 格。
 *  叶簇后续写入(叶覆写/其他石堆)破坏 3×2 一致性后,下一次 SquareTileFrame 触发
 *  本校验把残件清除(2026-08-16 原版服务器探针实证:JS 缺此链 → 树冠残件 187 多活)。
 *  帧重建算法与 place3x2 帧布局解耦(vanilla 54*style 平铺/本仓 35 wrap 均自洽)。 */
function check3x2Pile(st: TileStore, i: number, j: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) return;
  const ii = st.idx(i, j);
  if (!st.flags[ii] || st.type[ii] !== PILE2) return;
  const frameX = st.frameX[ii] | 0, frameY = st.frameY[ii] | 0;
  const num3 = Math.trunc(frameY / 36);
  const num4 = frameY % 36;
  let num = j - Math.trunc(num4 / 18);
  let num5 = Math.trunc(frameX / 18);
  let num6 = 0;
  while (num5 > 2) { num5 -= 3; num6++; }
  num5 = i - num5;
  const num7 = num6 * 54;
  const num8 = num + 2;
  let flag = false;
  for (let k = num5; k < num5 + 3; k++) {
    for (let l = num; l < num8; l++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(k, l)) { flag = true; continue; }
      const idx = st.idx(k, l);
      if (!st.flags[idx] || st.type[idx] !== PILE2
        || st.frameX[idx] !== (k - num5) * 18 + num7
        || st.frameY[idx] !== (l - num) * 18 + num3 * 36) flag = true;
    }
    if (!solidAt(st, k, num8)) flag = true;   // default 档支撑校验(SolidTileAllowBottomSlope,本阶段无 slope/half)
  }
  if (!flag) return;
  for (let k = num5; k < num5 + 3; k++) {
    for (let l = num; l < num8; l++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(k, l)) continue;
      const idx = st.idx(k, l);
      if (st.flags[idx] && st.type[idx] === PILE2) killTileGen(st, k, l);
    }
  }
}
```

        }

            return v.ToString("x8");

        // SW_GRID_DUMP="PassName:/pfx[,PassName2:/pfx2]"：pass 名命中时落
        // typ(LE16)/act/wal(LE16)/liq 裸数组（i=y*W+x 序，与 caves-oracle GRID_DUMP 同格式；
        // typ 为 RAW——保留 inactive 格残留 type（幽灵），与 oracle 一致）
        // SW_DUMP_ALL=<dir>：每个 pass 都落 <dir>/<idx>_<名>.{typ,act,wal,liq}
        private static void DumpGrids(string passName, int W, int H, Terraria.Tile[,] tile)
        {
            string dumpAll = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_DUMP_ALL");
            if (dumpAll != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    StringBuilder sbn = new StringBuilder();
                    foreach (char ch in passName)
                        sbn.Append(char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) ? ch : '_');
                    WriteGrid(dumpAll + "/" + _idx.ToString("000") + "_" + sbn.ToString(), W, H, tile);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#dumpall-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
                return;
            }
            string cfg = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_GRID_DUMP");
            if (cfg == null) return;
            foreach (string one in cfg.Split(','))
            {
                string[] kv = one.Split(':');
                if (kv.Length != 2 || kv[0] != passName) continue;
                try
                {
                    WriteGrid(kv[1], W, H, tile);
                    Mark("#griddump " + passName + " -> " + kv[1]);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#griddump-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
            }
        }
